query_info.key_query: WITH ACL_OWNER_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OWNER' AND CAN_READ = 1 ), ACL_OGROUP_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OGROUP' AND CAN_READ = 1 ), SHARE_RESOLVED AS ( SELECT S.TARGET_TYPE, S.TARGET_ID, S.DOC_SERIES_ID, CASE WHEN S.SHARED_IS_ALIAS = 1 THEN 'ALIAS:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID WHEN S.SHARE_TYPE = 0 THEN 'DEPT:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID ELSE 'USER:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID END AS PRINCIPAL_TAG FROM METAECM.V_ECM_SHARES S WHERE MOD(TRUNC(S.AUTHORITY / 2), 2) = 1 -- AUTHORITY 비트 2(읽기) 포함 여부 ) SELECT D.FOLDER_ID AS "dockey", -- 폴더 ID -- ── 폴더 식별/본문 ────────────────────────────────────────────── D.FOLDER_ID AS "folderId", -- 폴더 ID D.NAME AS "folderName", -- 폴더명 D.PARENT_ID AS "parentFolderId", -- 상위 폴더 ID -- ── 프로젝트 필터 : 기본 ───────────────────────────────────────── P.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", -- 프로젝트 ID P.PROJECTNO AS "projectNo", -- 프로젝트 번호 P.PJTNAME AS "pjtName", -- 등록명(국문) 구성요소1 P.MISNAME AS "completionNm" -- 준공명(등록명 구성요소2) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_FOLDERS D LEFT JOIN METAECM.V_ECM_PROJECTS P ON P.PROJECT_ID = D.PROJECT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND D.STATUS <> 'DELETED' -- 삭제 폴더 제외 (실제 코드값은 운영 DB 확인) AND P.PROJECTNO in ('20260382', '20260383', '20260384')
query_info.data_query:
WITH ACL_OWNER_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OWNER' AND CAN_READ = 1 ), ACL_OGROUP_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OGROUP' AND CAN_READ = 1 ), SHARE_RESOLVED AS ( SELECT S.TARGET_TYPE, S.TARGET_ID, S.DOC_SERIES_ID, CASE WHEN S.SHARED_IS_ALIAS = 1 THEN 'ALIAS:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID WHEN S.SHARE_TYPE = 0 THEN 'DEPT:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID ELSE 'USER:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID END AS PRINCIPAL_TAG FROM METAECM.V_ECM_SHARES S WHERE MOD(TRUNC(S.AUTHORITY / 2), 2) = 1 -- AUTHORITY 비트 2(읽기) 포함 여부 ) SELECT D.FOLDER_ID AS "dockey", -- 폴더 ID -- ── 폴더 식별/본문 ────────────────────────────────────────────── D.FOLDER_ID AS "folderId", -- 폴더 ID D.NAME AS "folderName", -- 폴더명 D.NAME_EN AS "folderNameEn", -- 폴더명(영문) D.NAME_CN AS "folderNameCn", -- 폴더명(중문) D.PARENT_ID AS "parentFolderId", -- 상위 폴더 ID D."TYPE" AS "folderType", -- 폴더 유형 D.STATUS AS "folderStatus", -- 폴더 상태 D.DESCRIPTION AS "folderDescription", -- 폴더 설명 D.FOLDER_PATH AS "folderPath", -- 폴더 경로 D.MAP_NAME AS "areaName", -- 전사문서/부서문서/프로젝트 D.CREATOR_ID AS "creatorId", -- 등록자 ID D.CREATOR_NAME AS "creatorName", -- 등록자명 TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdDate", -- 등록일 TO_CHAR(D.UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedDate", -- 수정일시
-- ── 프로젝트 필터 : 기본 ───────────────────────────────────────── P.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", -- 프로젝트 ID P.PROJECTNO AS "projectNo", -- 프로젝트 번호 P.PJTNAME AS "pjtName", -- 등록명(국문) 구성요소1 P.MISNAME AS "completionNm", -- 준공명(등록명 구성요소2)
-- ── ACL: 폴더 자체 ACL_ID 기준 권한 태그 ───────────────────────── D.ACL_ID AS "folderAclId", -- 폴더 ACL ID ( (SELECT LISTAGG(R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE || ':' || R.PRINCIPAL_ID, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE, R.PRINCIPAL_ID) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS R WHERE R.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID AND R.CAN_READ = 1 AND R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE NOT IN ('OWNER', 'OGROUP')) || (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACL_OWNER_FLAG O WHERE O.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID) THEN '|USER:' || TO_CHAR(D.CREATOR_ID) END) || (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACL_OGROUP_FLAG G WHERE G.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID) THEN '|' || (SELECT LISTAGG('DEPT:' || UG.GROUP_ID, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY UG.GROUP_ID) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_USER_GROUPS UG WHERE UG.USER_ID = D.CREATOR_ID) END) ) AS "aclPrincipalTags", -- ACL 권한 태그 목록('|' 구분)
-- ── 개별 공유(SHARE) 로 추가 열람 가능한 "권한 태그" 목록 (폴더 공유만 해당) ─ ( SELECT LISTAGG(SR.PRINCIPAL_TAG, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SR.PRINCIPAL_TAG) FROM SHARE_RESOLVED SR WHERE SR.TARGET_TYPE = 'FOLDER' AND SR.TARGET_ID = D.FOLDER_ID ) AS "sharePrincipalTags" -- 공유 권한 태그 목록('|' 구분)
FROM METAECM.V_ECM_FOLDERS D LEFT JOIN METAECM.V_ECM_PROJECTS P ON P.PROJECT_ID = D.PROJECT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND D.STATUS <> 'DELETED' -- 삭제 폴더 제외 (실제 코드값은 운영 DB 확인) AND D.FOLDER_ID=:folderId
